This 2008 Toyota Tundra SR5 in silver represents a capable full-size truck built to handle serious work and long-distance driving.

- i-Force 5.7L V8 DOHC engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD system for enhanced traction and capability
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS and electronic stability control
- Front dual zone air conditioning

- Remote keyless entry system
- Speed control for highway convenience
- Tilt steering wheel for driver comfort
- Front bucket seats with fabric trim and center armrest
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo management
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags with occupant sensing

- Heated power door mirrors
- Chrome bumpers with rear step bumper

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system including front dual impact bags, front side impact bags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip and stability, while ABS braking provides confident stopping power in emergency situations. A low tire pressure warning system alerts you to maintenance needs before they become serious.

Convenience features include remote keyless entry, speed control for relaxed highway driving, and an AM/FM audio system with 6-CD changer capability. The overhead console provides organized storage, while illuminated entry lighting helps you see clearly when entering the cab at night. Multiple reading lights and vanity mirrors support daily utility.

The split folding rear seat adapts to your needs, whether you're transporting passengers or need maximum cargo space. Chrome bumpers front and rear contribute to the truck's purposeful appearance while the rear step bumper facilitates bed access. Variably intermittent wipers automatically adjust to rain intensity for clear visibility.

This Tundra SR5 has established itself as a dependable workhorse ready for whatever you need from a full-size truck. Visit our showroom to see it in person and discuss how it fits your needs.
